hooks.text: 飞船强度来自货舱里技术模块的咬合关系，购买什么以及放在哪里都会改变性能。
hooks.excerpt: In Konfronto you build your starship by purchasing cargo from the intergalactic trader, and then arranging them in your ship’s hold. Where you place them matters.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 飞行员要么清理货舱扩展构筑空间，要么驾驶战机提高战力，同一人无法同时承担两项工作。
hooks.excerpt: Expand your playing area by sending Pilots out to clear space in the cargo hold. Or put your Pilots in command of spaceships to increase your power, but they can’t do both at the same time.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 银河对手来自其他玩家已经完成的飞船构筑，即使对方离线也能进行异步正面对战。
hooks.excerpt: Meet other players’ creations in head to head battles! Don’t worry, the game is asynchronous. They don't even have to be online when you inevitably crush them.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
